description: An action-worded 'within N days' is YOUR deadline (no calendar date printed); an agency-worded 'within N days' is a processing window. They must land in different buckets.

BIRCH COUNTY HUMAN SERVICES

It is time to renew your benefits.

Items we need from you: send copies.
